hints.title: Reachable Rooms Obstacle
hints.text: Starting with room 0 unlocked, keys found inside accessible rooms unlock further rooms. How can tracking visited rooms confirm whether every room from 0 to N-1 is reachable?

hints.title: Connected Reachability Invariant
hints.text: The set of visitable rooms is the connected component containing vertex 0 in the directed room-key graph.

hints.title: Standard Traversal Procedure
hints.text: Maintain a visited set containing 0 and a queue initialized with room 0. While queue is non-empty, pop current room. For each key in rooms[current], if key is not in visited, add key to visited and enqueue. After traversal, return whether len(visited) == len(rooms).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: E: total number of keys across rooms (E <= 3000)
complexity.notes: Every room and key is processed at most once in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly scanning rooms without visited tracking causes infinite cycles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited tracking set uses O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Modeling room unlocking as standard directed graph reachability from vertex 0.
